v2mwry7n.baseName: Walplus 112 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Nan - 182 cm
v2mwry7n.variantName: Walplus 112 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Nan - 182 cm
v2mwry7n.sourceDescription: This LED Christmas Tree with Spikes elevates your holiday decor with dynamic lighting patterns and a sleek modern design fit for both indoor and sheltered outdoor settings. Designed for those looking to enhance their festive display, this tree blends seamlessly with a variety of settings, from living rooms to garden spaces. Artfully crafted from metal, it presents an enduring piece that withstands the seasonal wear and tear, adding a lively touch to your festive celebrations. Dynamic Lighting Effects The LED Christmas Tree offers dynamic lighting that continuously changes patterns, creating a captivating visual display. With eight modes, you can personalize how your tree lights up the holidays, turning ordinary moments into memorable events. USB-Powered Convenience This tree is engineered to be powered through USB, making it versatile and convenient for use without traditional power adapters. Simply plug it into any USB port, whether it's a power bank, computer, or adapter, for instant festive illumination. Durable Metal Construction Built with solid metal, the tree provides a robust structure that is abrasion resistant. This choice in material extends the product's life, even in high traffic locations, ensuring it remains part of your seasonal decor for many future gatherings. Versatile Use Suitable for both the living room and sheltered outdoor spaces like patios or terraces, this tree adapts well to various environments, offering consistent festive charm whether displayed in a cozy nook or open veranda. Simple Care and Maintenance To maintain its quality appearance, a simple wipe with a dry cloth is all it takes. This ease of maintenance heightens user convenience, allowing more time for enjoyment rather than upkeep. Product Specifications Colour: Multicolour Material: Metal Tree height: 182 cm Durable Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Multicolour Number of LEDs: 112 LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Cable length: 500 cm Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x LED christmas tree This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

h1tf8rcr.baseName: Vivo Technologies 360 Degree Rotating Christmas Tree Stand
h1tf8rcr.variantName: Vivo Technologies 360 Degree Rotating Christmas Tree Stand
h1tf8rcr.sourceDescription: This durable rotating Christmas tree stand is made from high quality ABS material, providing a lightweight yet sturdy base to keep your tree balanced and stable while rotating. It supports trees up to 8 ft tall with a load capacity of up to 35 kg and includes a pole adapter for centre pole diameters of 3/4", 7/8" and 1 1/4". The stand is easy to assemble using the four legs and base grooves, while its smooth 360 degree rotation can operate clockwise or anticlockwise at 2.4 rotations per minute. It offers three operating modes, allowing the tree to rotate with lights on, remain stationary with lights on, or stay stationary with lights off. Specifications: High quality ABS construction, load capacity up to 35 kg, suitable for Christmas trees up to 8 ft tall with the included adapter, compatible with centre pole diameters of 3/4", 7/8" and 1 1/4", 360 degree clockwise and anticlockwise rotation, rotation speed of 2.4 rotations per minute, three operating modes, and easy assembly. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG
